blocks.text: The module header makes this the only Pusher integration point and states the fire-and-forget, per-channel, exact-schema, and no-session no-op rules.
blocks.title: Relay contract

blocks.text: EventType enumerates agent, lifecycle, notification, workspace, proposal, local-tool, and MCP event names. The enum is the source for VALID_EVENT_TYPES and selected NOTIFY_KINDS.
blocks.title: Closed event vocabulary

blocks.text: Session, user, and workspace identifiers are defensively replaced outside Pusher's allowed channel characters and receive distinct prefixes.
blocks.title: Channel naming

blocks.text: The optional Request patch avoids double ASCII escaping and stale signatures. _get_client lazily reads configuration, imports pusher, applies the patch, and sticks to unavailable after setup failure.
blocks.title: Pusher client setup

blocks.text: _fit_event_to_pusher_cap measures the fully serialized UTF-8 envelope, then progressively removes image data, truncates summary on byte boundaries, or replaces payload with a minimal fallback.
blocks.title: Envelope size fitting

blocks.text: emit_event validates the identifier and event type, gets the client, builds the session envelope, marks shrinkage, triggers the session channel, and returns False on relay failures.
blocks.title: Session event publishing

blocks.text: The user and workspace functions repeat the same validation, fitting, truncation marking, and fire-and-forget behavior with their respective identifier fields and channel schemes.
blocks.title: User and workspace publishing

gotchas: Unknown event types are skipped rather than raised.
Payload fitting drops image, then shrinks summary, then uses a minimal placeholder.
how_it_works: Defines EventType and derived event sets
Fits envelopes to the serialized byte cap
Triggers events and returns success status
purpose: This module is the relay boundary between backend work and live frontend updates. It defines the event vocabulary, sanitizes channel identifiers, lazily creates the Pusher client, shrinks oversized envelopes, and treats relay failures as logged side-channel failures.
side_effects: lazy monkey patch of pusher Request
summary: Publishes validated, size-bounded agent and workspace events to Pusher without blocking agent work.

symbols.summary: Enumerates every event name accepted by the relay's session, user, and workspace publishers.
Sanitizes a session identifier and prefixes it as a Pusher session channel.
Sanitizes a user identifier and prefixes it as a personal Pusher channel.
Sanitizes a workspace identifier and prefixes it as a workspace Pusher channel.

raises: Underlying pusher attribute errors may propagate
symbols.summary: Patches pusher Request initialization to preserve UTF-8 body sizing and recompute its signature.
Lazily creates and caches a configured Pusher client, or disables relay when unavailable.
Returns the original or a progressively reduced event envelope that fits the serialized byte cap.
Publishes one validated event to a session channel without letting relay failures interrupt work.
Publishes one validated event to a user's personal channel with fire-and-forget failure handling.
Publishes one validated event to a workspace channel for cross-tab live updates.

unknowns: Pusher credentials and deployment configuration are supplied outside this module.
